precision.description: Decimal precision of the main number in the metric tile.

placeholder.description: A placeholder to be used when the field is not a numerical value and thus NaN at client-side.

placeholderHintMessage.description: Hint message to display when indicator value is using placeholder

dataSourceValue.description:
Indicates where the main value should be taken from.
If value is `mainValue`, the metric value will be displayed using the value coming from the
{@link UiSdlMetricTileMainValue#singleValue} or the other echarts values coming from mainValue spec and
`metricName`. If value is one of the others {@link UiSdlMetricTileDataSources}, the main value will be displayed
using the value coming from that source results.

aggregation.description: Aggregation function to be used for rolling up results of all individual sources into 1 timeseries.

dataRecordMapping.description: The data record mapping used to map records to fields in UiDesigner.

metricName.description: The name of the metric to which these settings apply.

dataType.description:
The type on which the metric is defined. Used to override {@link UiSdlComponentDataSpec#dataType}
when we want to show metrics defined on different types in the same component

bindings.description:
This variable provides a way to provide values for fields at runtime for metrics.
Refer to {@link EvalMetricSpec#bindings} for more information

entityId.description:
Id for the source type
Refer to {@link EvalMetricSpec#id} for more information

unit.description: {@link Unit} to be used for the metric

options.description: {@link EvalMetricsOptions} to be taken into account when evaluating the metric.

interval.description: Interval at which metric will be evaluated. Default value is DAY.

evaluateAction.description:
Keeps track of the evalute action triggered in the datasource. Possible values
are evalMetric or rollupMetrics. Defaults to 'EVAL'.

filter.description: Filter string used in the evalMetrics/rollupMetrics call, defaults to '1==1'.

title: Spec describing how to evaluate the main value of a {@link UiSdlMetricTile}, using Metric based calls.
name: UiSdlMetricTileDataSpecMainValueSetting
